sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_bookings FROM bookings WHERE property_id = 'beach-resort' AND status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 500
policy: Hotel policy: Hotel Group Brand Standards > Cancellation

answer: There were 365 cancelled bookings at Beach Resort. The hotel group's flexible rate allows free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival, while cancellations inside 48 hours are charged one night plus tax [Hotel Group Brand Standards > Cancellation].
message: Counts cancelled bookings at the Beach Resort; the cancellation policy is in [Hotel policy: Hotel Group Brand Standards > Cancellation].

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM bookings AS b JOIN properties AS p ON b.property_id = p.id WHERE p.id = 'mountain-lodge' LIMIT 500
